content: {"status":"available","text":"材料明确承认的局限较有限。在 English constituency parsing 上，Transformer 仍逊于 Recurrent Neural Network Grammar (E061)。机制层面，averaging attention-weighted positions 会降低 effective resolution，需由 Multi-Head Attention 补偿 (E016)；缩小 attention key size d_k 会损害质量，暗示 dot product 未必是理想的 compatibility function (E051)。此外，面向 images、audio、video 等非文本模态与 large inputs and outputs 的 local, restricted attention 仅属未来计划，尚未验证 (E066)。","sources":["E016","E051","E061","E066"]}
